notes: Hints no longer cost puzzle rating: a hint just makes that puzzle unrated. Prefer the Lichess way? Turn on "Hints cost rating" in the puzzle settings.
Chrome: every new version now shows an Update card on Home and a dot on the menu, with Download, unzip and Reload steps.
After a game: train your opening in a Chessable course you own, or in Openings.
Progress: a puzzle rating chart, your solve rate, and your strongest and weakest puzzle themes.
Play Coach: start from an opening (Italian, Sicilian, London…) or from any position (FEN).
Home: a weekly report every Monday with your training days, rating change, puzzles, reviews and next focus.
Clearer empty pages, and more texts translated.
